title: Branches: create, switch, merge and delete

videos.script: Here is the thing almost everybody gets wrong about branches. {{wrong}} They think a branch is a copy. A second folder, a duplicate of the project where you can make a mess. {{copy}} It is not. A branch is a name for one commit. That is all it is. A file with forty characters in it. {{name}} Making one copies nothing, so it takes no time and no space. And that changes how you work. {{cheap}} Every piece of work gets its own branch. The Sunday hours on one, the new prices on another. {{two}} Each commit moves only the branch you are on, so the two never touch. {{apart}} And when a piece of work is ready, you merge it. Sometimes Git just slides the name forward. Sometimes it writes a commit with two parents, one from each side. {{merge}} This lesson makes branches, switches between them, merges them and deletes them. And by the end, the word branch will mean exactly what Git means by it. {{title}}
